requirements.title: Valid credentials redirect to inventory page
requirements.description: When a user submits a valid username and password the application redirects them to the inventory page.
requirements.expectedOutcome: User is redirected to /inventory.html after submitting valid credentials.
preconditions: SAUCE_STANDARD_USER and SAUCE_PASSWORD environment variables are set
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting valid username and password navigates to /inventory.html
No error message is displayed after successful login

requirements.title: Invalid username shows authentication error
requirements.description: When a user submits an unrecognised username an inline error message is displayed and the user remains on the login page.
requirements.expectedOutcome: An inline error message is visible and the login page remains active.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting an unrecognised username shows the error 'Username and password do not match any user in this service'
The user remains on the login page after the failed attempt

requirements.title: Invalid password shows authentication error
requirements.description: When a user submits a valid username with an incorrect password an inline error message is displayed and the user remains on the login page.
requirements.expectedOutcome: An inline error message is visible and the login page remains active.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting a valid username with a wrong password shows the error 'Username and password do not match any user in this service'
The user remains on the login page after the failed attempt

requirements.title: Empty credentials show required-field validation error
requirements.description: When a user submits the login form with no fields filled in a validation error is displayed indicating the username is required.
requirements.expectedOutcome: A required-field validation error is visible and the login page remains active.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the form with empty fields shows the error 'Username is required'
The user remains on the login page after the failed attempt

requirements.title: Locked-out user sees account-locked error
requirements.description: When a user whose account is locked submits valid credentials an account-locked error message is displayed and the user remains on the login page.
requirements.expectedOutcome: An account-locked error message is visible and the login page remains active.
preconditions: SAUCE_LOCKED_USER and SAUCE_PASSWORD environment variables are set
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting credentials for a locked account shows the error 'Sorry, this user has been locked out'
The user remains on the login page after the failed attempt
